scope: Right-column scrolling when criteria, backend services and source metadata are expanded
method: Chrome, dedicated verification tab, real UI clicks and wheel scroll; read-only DOM geometry measurements

before.defect: Expanded criteria reduced the code panel to 119 px and the source body to 0 px; the entire right column could not scroll.

after.result: Wheel scrolling revealed the source code, diagnostics and all three evidence rows without moving the conversation.

expandedCode.state: Source details and services retracted; expand then return controls exercised.

preview.result: Switching from Code back to the live comparison retained the application iframe.

mobile.result: The page kept its natural mobile scroll; the source and evidence could be passed with wheel scrolling.

limitations: Single Chrome engine; not an assistive-technology audit.
Browser observations establish geometry and scrolling, not pixel-level fidelity or human usability.
Desktop minimum work-area height can move the evidence footer below the fold; the right column now makes it reachable.
No project data, delegation, proposal or source content was changed by these checks.
cleanup: Temporary viewport override reset after verification.
